about_the_game:
You are a lost soul wandering through the ruins of a long forgotten society. You and up to seven other friends are tasked with protecting Jane, a young woman trapped in a perpetual cycle of death and rebirth. Use powerful spells and weapons to fight your way through the stronghold to uncover ancient knowledge and meet a powerful deity held deep within its chambers.

Gather a team of 8 souls controlling one vessel and face unknowable dangers in this cooperative turn-based dungeon crawler. Collect unique skill and spell cards that will aid you and your team in combat. Each card provides a unique benefit, granting useful buffs to one of your friends, weakening an enemy, mending your teammates wounds and damaging monsters that block your path.

Coordination and cooperation is important for success, maybe you have a party member that specializes entirely on damage, maybe they could use a little bit of healing every now and then! You may even a whole team of casters that needs a quick boost to their spells, or you could all focus on making one party member a powerhouse capable of annihilating anything in their path!

short_description: Fight for your life in the endless halls of a primordial stronghold to escape an endless cycle. You and up to 7 of your friends can coordinate, strategize and conqueror the dungeon together, or you can face the horrors alone.
